title: East St. Louis roadhouse and the stockyard
summary: Clarifies the Kahoken was in East St. Louis by the stockyards; Creath played five nights a week there.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: And did he travel much outside of St. Louis? Did he go over to East St. Louis?
No, this was East St. Louis.

Out in the... They called it the Stockyard. That's where they have all the cattle; they killed cattle and livestock there. The Stockyard. And then we played the Kahoken(?) Roadhouse. But it's out in East St. Louis. And it's where they kill all the cattle and dump all the filth out there, you know. It's just a nice smell... There was such a nice smell out there.

That was then his location. What other kinds of things did you do during the day, or the evening, I should say, when you were working with Charlie Creath at the Roadhouse after-hours. Were you playing with anyone else? Or did he have another gig?

No. He didn't play anywhere else. Because I think he was doing five nights a week. And we'd come out of there, get out of there around six, seven o'clock in the morning, and I would sleep...sleep all day, you know.
There were no trips to, say, New Orleans or Shreveport? Did Charlie Creath ever take any musicians down to New Orleans...
